J3.evidence: Reviewer's stated reason is wrong: the English does translate this entry on {أَتَّخَذْنَاهُمْ} (38:63), not 38:6. But the English still needs a fix. (1) It adds a Latin transliteration of the Quranic word, '(ittakhadhnāhum)', which is not in the Arabic. That is an unmarked addition and also a forbidden Latin transliteration. (2) For «رجالاً مَقُولاً فيهم: أتخذناهم» it writes 'did we take them...' in English and drops the Arabic «أتخذناهم», so the parsed word is not kept in Arabic script. (3) «قرأ الأخَوان» is rendered 'Al-Kisāʾī, Ḥamza' with no marking, which silently replaces 'the two brothers' with an identification. The Turkish handles this with a parenthesis. (4) The translator's notes use '(Translator's note: …)' instead of the required «[Translator's note: …]». The rest is accurate: muttaṣila/munqaṭiʿa, «ما لنا», the 3778→3878 note.
